## Work I Completed

I created and tested the main Python program for the Firewall Analyzer project. This included reading firewall log data from a CSV file, using pandas to group and summarize the data, creating connection summaries, generating basic firewall rule suggestions, and exporting the results to Excel files.

I also made the project decisions about the purpose of the tool, including focusing on firewall log review, destination port summaries, and firewall rule planning.
